theme: Light theme (mountain tones + kilim ornaments) with premium editorial studio-site feel.

typography.instructions: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1-H3 to maintain continuity with the /history section, but set in dark mountain tones. Use Manrope for body text (clean, highly readable on rural connections, slightly wider tracking). Use JetBrains Mono for small overlines, RU/EN language switchers, and subtle labels (like tags or image captions). Headings must be tight (tracking-tight) while Mono text must be wide (tracking-[0.1em]).

colors.instructions: CRITICAL: The existing dark history section (/history) must remain untouched. The portal uses this new warm, airy, earthy palette. Use terracotta and gold sparingly for active states, borders, buttons, and kilim-inspired SVG ornaments. Never use pure black or gray, always tint with the mountain navy (#1A2433) or warm beige.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #D1CFC7 (subtle earthy border for bento grid cards).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Avoid heavy drop shadows. Use very subtle, warm ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(26,36,51,0.04)]) on hover only. The layout should feel like a flat, premium editorial magazine.
visual_enhancers.textures: SVG Kilim patterns used at low opacity (e.g., 3-5%) as background watermark adornments, particularly in headers, the footer, or empty space.

grids.bento_culture: Use a 'Tetris-style' Bento grid for the 9 culture cards on the Culture page (e.g., col-span-full md:col-span-8, col-span-4). Never use standard symmetrical 3x3 grids. Build asymmetry.
grids.gallery_masonry: Use CSS columns (columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6) for the masonry photo gallery to eliminate jagged bottoms. Ensure all images are lazy-loaded.

layouts.hero: Fullscreen height (min-h-[90vh]) with the real Andarak mountains photo. Apply a light framer-motion scroll parallax (y-axis). IMPORTANT: Overlay must be a bottom-up gradient (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1A2433]/60 via-[#1A2433]/20 to-transparent) or very light scrim so the image isn't ruined by a dark blanket. Slogan 'Земля, где встречаются эпохи' should be massive (text-5xl to text-7xl fluid), Cormorant Garamond.
layouts.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F8F7F3]/85 border-b border-[#D1CFC7]/50). Grouped dropdowns (Culture, Life, Guests, Students) using Shadcn DropdownMenu. Left: Logo. Right: RU/EN switcher + Hamburger sheet on mobile. No fully transparent headers.
layouts.footer: Deep contrast footer (bg-[#1A2433] text-[#F8F7F3]). Large typography for the contact/suggestion CTA, and a language switcher. Include emergency floating contact button fixed at the bottom right.

motion.scroll: Utilize Lenis smooth scroll for momentum and weight, maintaining parity with the /history experience.
motion.reveal: Use framer-motion for smooth fade-up-and-in reveals (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}) on scroll for text blocks and cards.
motion.image_parallax: Slight `scale` or `y` translation on images within overflow-hidden containers to create high-end depth when hovered or scrolled.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #1A2433 text on #F8F7F3 backgrounds easily passes WCAG AAA.
accessibility.performance: CRUCIAL: Due to slow rural internet in Andarak, ALL images must include `loading="lazy"`. Avoid heavy 3D WebGL canvases on the portal side. The page must be lightweight.

component_instructions.dropdown_menu: Use Shadcn DropdownMenu for grouped nav. Override styles with our background (#F8F7F3), text colors, and 1px border. Never use transparent dropdown backgrounds.
component_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp rectangular based on feel, but must be solid terracotta (#C25934) or outlined with terracotta text. Add scale-down micro-interaction on click.
component_instructions.lightbox: For the gallery, use framer-motion AnimatePresence to render a fullscreen modal. Add `backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#1A2433]/90` for the modal background.
component_instructions.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-explore-button').

hero_mountain.description: Aerial summer valley between mountains. Use for the Home Hero.

winter_street.description: Winter mountain street. Use for 'Life in Andarak' section.

mosque_dome.description: Snowy mosque dome. Use for the 'Culture & Traditions' cards.

memorial_arch.description: Memorial arch on hill. Use for 'About the Project' or historical context.

market_lane.description: Market lane/people. Use for the 'For Guests / Directories' preview.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align standard text containers (preserve left alignment for human reading flow). Prioritize semantic HTML and WCAG standards. Add layered depths, ensure micro-animations on all interactive elements. Do not override the dark theme for the /history route (ensure React router manages theme context or CSS scope separation properly). Never use placeholder URLs, only the provided unsplash URLs. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case. Do not apply `transition: all`. Emphasize generous spacing (p-8 to p-24) to establish a high-end feel.
